Reads and deletions still work.
billingBanner.blockedEffects: OwnSand rejects creating sandboxes, snapshots, templates and enrollment tokens, resuming sandboxes, exporting snapshots, and enrolling a device even with an existing enrollment token. Running sandboxes, exec, reads and deletions still work.
billingBanner.suspendOn: Unless billing is fixed, the organization is suspended on {time} and its running sandboxes are paused.

signIn.tagline: Run sandboxes on the devices your team already owns.
notFound.title: Page not found
organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Choose an organization to manage its devices and sandboxes.
organizations.empty.title: You are not in an organization yet
organizations.empty.description: Create one, or open an invitation link from an admin.
organizations.join.title: Join with an invitation
organizations.createDialog.title: Create an organization
organizations.createDialog.description: You become its owner. You can invite members after you create it.
organizations.createDialog.unconfirmed: The organization may have been created. Close this dialog and check the organization list before trying again.
organizations.createDialog.name: Organization name
sandboxes.title: Sandboxes
sandboxes.description: Sandboxes run on your organization's devices. The console does not show command output or file contents.
sandboxes.empty.title: No sandboxes match
sandboxes.empty.description: Create a sandbox, or change the filters.
sandboxes.table.label: Sandbox list
sandboxes.createDialog.title: Create a sandbox
sandboxes.createDialog.description: Choose the source, resources and time limits. There is no default TTL.
sandboxes.createDialog.idleTtlDescriptio: Ends the sandbox after this long without activity.
sandboxes.createDialog.deviceUnavailable: The selected device is unavailable. Choose a device or select {anyDevice}.
sandboxes.createDialog.labelsDescription: One key=value per line. Every member and API key can read labels, so never put secrets in them.
sandboxes.createDialog.unconfirmedExpire: The sandbox may have been created. The retry window has ended. Check the sandbox list before creating another sandbox.
sandboxes.createDialog.unconfirmedRetry: The sandbox may have been created. Retry the original request to recover the sandbox.
sandbox.title: Sandbox
sandbox.pauseRequested: Pause requested. Check the sandbox status.
sandbox.resumeRequested: Resume requested. Check the sandbox status.
sandbox.deleteDialog.title: Delete this sandbox?
sandbox.deleteDialog.description: The sandbox and its disk are deleted on the device. Snapshots of it stay.
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Your own machines that run sandboxes. A new device runs nothing until an admin sets its limits.
devices.empty.title: No devices yet
devices.empty.description: An admin creates an enrollment token and installs the agent on a device.
devices.table.label: Device list
device.title: Device
device.limits.title: Limits
device.limits.description: The sandboxes on this device share these limits. vCPU overcommit lets the scheduler allocate more vCPUs than the limit; memory and disk are never overcommitted.
device.remove.title: Remove device
device.remove.description: Revokes the device credentials and ends its sandboxes. The agent deletes its local data when it reconnects.
device.remove.dialogDescription: Its sandboxes end and it can no longer connect. To use the machine again, enroll it as a new device.
members.title: Members
members.description: People who can use this organization. Profiles come from your Delino account.
members.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
members.removeDialog.description: They lose access to this organization. Its sandboxes keep running.
members.leaveDialog.title: Leave this organization?
members.leaveDialog.description: You lose access to its devices and sandboxes. An admin can invite you again.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.revokeDialog.title: Revoke invitation {invitation}?
invitations.revokeDialog.description: The invitation link stops working at once. It cannot be restored; create a new link instead.
invitations.createDialog.description: You get a one-time link that works for 7 days. Send it to the person you invite.
invitations.secret.title: Your invitation link
invitations.secret.label: Invitation link
apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Programs such as CI jobs and AI agents use API keys to manage sandboxes. A key cannot read members.
apiKeys.createDialog.title: Create an API key
apiKeys.createDialog.nameRequired: Enter a name, for example the program that uses the key.
apiKeys.createDialog.name: Name
apiKeys.createDialog.nameDescription: Helps you recognize the key later.
apiKeys.secret.title: Your new API key
apiKeys.secret.label: API key
apiKeys.secret.hint: Set it as {variable} for the SDK or the CLI.
apiKeys.revokeDialog.title: Revoke {name}?
apiKeys.revokeDialog.description: Programs that use the key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
enrollmentTokens.title: Enrollment tokens
enrollmentTokens.description: A token adds exactly one device to this organization. It works once and expires within 24 hours.
enrollmentTokens.revokeDialog.title: Revoke token {token}?
enrollmentTokens.revokeDialog.descriptio: The token stops working at once. It cannot be restored; create a new token instead.
enrollmentTokens.createDialog.title: Create an enrollment token
enrollmentTokens.secret.title: Your new enrollment token
enrollmentTokens.secret.label: Enrollment token
enrollmentTokens.secret.hint: On the device, run {command} and paste the token on standard input. Do not pass it as a command-line argument.
snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: Snapshots stay on their device. Export one to use it on other devices with the same OS and architecture.
snapshots.empty.title: No snapshots
snapshots.empty.description: Take a snapshot from a running or paused sandbox.
snapshots.deleteDialog.title: Delete the snapshot {id}?
snapshots.deleteDialog.description: Delete its templates first. Sandboxes made from it keep running.
templates.title: Templates
templates.empty.title: No templates
templates.empty.description: A template gives a snapshot a name to create sandboxes from.
templates.createDialog.title: Make a template
templates.createDialog.name: Template name
templates.deleteDialog.title: Delete the template {name}?
settings.title: Settings
agentPolicy.versionRequired: Enter the agent version to pin, for example {example}.
agentPolicy.saved: The agent version policy is saved.
agentPolicy.title: Agent version policy
agentPolicy.description: Decides which agent version the devices of this organization install.
agentPolicy.adminsOnly: Only admins can change the policy.
ownership.title: Transfer ownership
ownership.description: The new owner gets every permission. You become an admin.
ownership.dialog.title: Make {name} the owner?
ownership.dialog.description: You become an admin. Only the new owner can give ownership back. The transfer removes the billing link, so the organization is blocked until the new owner links a billing account.
deleteOrganization.title: Delete organization
deleteOrganization.description: Ends every sandbox and removes every device, API key and member.
deleteOrganization.dialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteOrganization.dialog.description: Every sandbox ends and every device is removed. This cannot be undone.
billing.unlinkedOwner: No billing account is linked. OwnSand rejects new sandboxes, snapshots, templates and enrollment tokens until you link one.
billing.unlinkedAdmin: No billing account is linked. The organization owner must link one.
billing.usageNote: Usage of about the last 10 minutes is not included yet. R2 storage shows in GiB-months of 730 hours.
billing.title: Billing
billing.description: OwnSand charges the usage of this organization to a Delino billing account. Pay, top up and manage billing accounts at {site}.
billing.unlinkDialog.title: Unlink {name}?
billing.unlinkDialog.description: The organization becomes blocked at once: OwnSand rejects new sandboxes, snapshots, templates and enrollment tokens until you link a billing account again. Usage so far stays on this billing account.
billing.unlinkDialog.accountChanged: The linked billing account changed. Review the current account and confirm again.
billing.linkDialog.none: You are not an owner or admin of any billing account. Create a billing account at {site}, then link it here.
billing.linkDialog.description: OwnSand charges the usage of {name} to the billing account you choose. You can choose a billing account in which you are an owner or admin.
invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.missingLink: This page needs an invitation link. Ask an admin of the organization for a new one.
invitation.mayHaveJoined: You may have joined the organization.
invitation.invited: You are invited to an OwnSand organization
invitation.signInToAccept: Sign in to accept the invitation.
invitation.joinDescription: You join as the signed-in user. The invitation works only once.
